purpose: A model parameter over temper (ngspice temper-1.cir) takes its value at the nominal 27 C

oracle.derivation: is = temper + 1000 = 1027 at 27 C; the 1 mA source sets v(1) = Vt ln(1 + 1e-3/1027), Vt = k/q*300.15 with ngspice's k = 1.38064852e-23 and q = 1.6021766208e-19; gmin*v(1) is 2.5e-20 A.
oracle.corroboration: ngspice-44.2 agrees to 8.9e-11 relative (SPICE_ASCIIRAWFILE=1 ngspice -n -b -r ref.raw temper_model_is.sp)
